uncertain: The four elevation pictures are captioned only 'Elewacja domu Wena - 1..4'; sides were assigned from the plans: 1 = FRONT (gable with entrance recess at the right and kitchen slot window), 2 = RIGHT (long side, porch recess at its left end, roof windows), 3 = REAR (gable with the living-room glazing), 4 = LEFT (long side with the timber box).

wallLeftPx/wallRightPx and sideLengthM are the GROUND-FLOOR wall faces (8.80 / 11.20). The upper-floor timber box projects 1.30 m further on the plan-left side (FRONT x 342..381, REAR x 641..681); with the box the upper floor is 10.10 m wide.

No section is published. ridgeAboveZeroM 8.16 = page building height 8.46 minus about 0.30 m of terrain read off the elevations (zero row 478, ground row 488, 31.8 px/m); neither the terrain offset nor the upper floor level (2.9, read from the bottom of the gable French doors) is printed.
On the long sides the roofing ridge line is at row 227-228; the gable verges are raised parapets whose top is at row 216, which is also the apex row seen on the gable elevations.

RIGHT R1 is a small window in a wall that faces right but stands inside the porch recess, not in the right outer wall; on the elevation it shows as two bright panes inside a dark slot. Counting it or not is a matter of definition.
RIGHT R6 is probably a roof-access hatch.
LEFT L1 and L3 reach the floor on the elevation but have no door leaf on the plan: WINDOW chosen; GLAZED_DOOR is the other reading.
FRONT F2: the door leaf is partly in the recess shadow; its top and left edge are read from the darker brown area, the recess opening is x 604..647.
The stone-clad block beside the house on pictures 2 (x 644..767) and 4 (x 257..380) is the terrace screen wall, not house wall.
